rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a feeling of dissatisfaction or disapproval.

example.english: I have strong displeasure with this decision.
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 hou2 bat1 mun5

rows.note: Use this for a troublesome matter that causes irritation rather than for the feeling itself.

example.english: This whole matter is a real displeasure.
example.jyutping: ni1 daan1 je5 zan1 hai6 maa4 faan4

rows.note: Use this colloquial noun phrase for an annoying or troublesome thing, especially a concrete cause of displeasure.

example.english: Please get rid of this annoying displeasure-causing stuff quickly.
example.traditional: 呢堆麻煩嘢唔該快啲掉咗佢。
example.jyutping: ni1 deoi1 maa4 faan4 je5 m4 goi1 faai3 di1 deu6 zo2 keoi5
